game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade, a row of broken columns: the relic hunter must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Backpack Append: Use append and remove to manage the relic hunter's backpack list as ghost knights drop loot.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade: a row of broken columns
core_gameplay_loop: In Broken Colonnade, repeat each round: Use append and remove to manage the relic hunter's backpack list as ghost knights drop loot. Each round, ghost knights strike the glyph door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the bag_space value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the glyph door from ghost knights in Broken Colonnade: keep the bag_space meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: bag_space drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 1 (intro tier): Backpack Append
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Backpack Append' (Week 7 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Broken Colonnade'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bag_space changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Broken Colonnade.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while bag_space > 0.
